pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-brown polygonal regions with soft-edged gradients. Spatial area of patches increases from the neck towards the mid-flank, transitioning from small, dense rhombohedrons to larger, irregular quadrilaterals.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate intersections. The pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively consistent across the lateral view of the body.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a short, dense vertical pile with low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the dorsal line of the neck, though slightly obscured by focal blur.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of dark, circular, punctate marks is visible on the lower shoulder and chest region, indicating localized textural disruption.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-colored avian forms clinging to the lateral surfaces of the neck and shoulder region.
